statement: Original HypothesesH prime including named definite-inner-form base change and polarized cuspidal attachment; inherited BCS/GUA boundaries remain unchanged.

Original bz, geo, zel, gen, multi and exh: admissibility/Jacquet finite length, geometric lemma, support uniqueness, generic unlinked segment and Langlands classification. No replacement by a spherical-only correspondence.
Full original IsRecT laws and RecTExists, including rank, cuspidal irreducibility, segment and sum laws, finite inertia semisimplicity and rank-one Artin normalization.
Original Gelfand–Kazhdan and normalized-induction smooth-dual pairing. The exact dual support/field transport and given-rho polarization consumers are proved in HAW4/14.
Original strong multiplicity one and Chebotarev. CAP6 is the separately bound numbered degree-one density input; finite matrix-algebra semisimple comparison is proved in HAW1.

Actual positive-rank cusps have their original continuous central Hecke character; the norm-one idele class group is compact. HAW6 reconstructs the single global unitarizing norm twist and full WinOf consumer.

Original local/global Artin reciprocity, exact geometric Artin cyclotomic formula, finite local embeddings, density of Weil in decomposition group, transitivity on prolongations and CM conjugation dictionary.

Finite-dimensional matrix-algebra density/Burnside and Wedderburn, weak Nullstellensatz and elementary generalized-character blocks. The needed trace, ordered-flag and quotient-functional consumers are explicitly proved.
